system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: Lp(a)HORIZON NCT04023552 - Assessing the Impact of Lipoprotein (a) Lowering With Pelacarsen (TQJ230) on Major Cardiovascular Events in Patients With CVD
Investigational drug: pelacarsen
Document: On-treatment platelet reactivity through the thromboxane A<sub>2</sub> or P2Y12 platelet receptor pathways is not affected by pelacarsen. (journal, published 2023-06-20, source pmid:37338713)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
On-treatment platelet reactivity through the thromboxane A<sub>2</sub> or P2Y12 platelet receptor pathways is not affected by pelacarsen.

Background Pelacarsen decreases plasma levels of lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] and oxidized phospholipids (OxPL). It was previously reported that pelacarsen does not affect the platelet count. We now report the effect of pelacarsen on on-treatment platelet reactivity. Methods Subjects with established cardiovascular disease and screening Lp(a) levels ≥60 mg per deciliter (~ ≥150 nmol/L) were randomized to receive pelacarsen (20, 40, or 60 mg every 4 weeks; 20 mg every 2 weeks; or 20 mg every week), or placebo for 6-12 months. Aspirin Reaction Units (ARU) and P2Y12 Reaction Units (PRU) were measured at baseline and the primary analysis timepoint (PAT) at 6 months. Results Of the 286 subjects randomized, 275 had either an ARU or PRU test, 159 (57.8%) were on aspirin alone and 94 (34.2%) subjects were on dual anti-platelet therapy. As expected, the baseline ARU and PRU were suppressed in subjects on aspirin or on dual anti-platelet therapy, respectively. There were no significant differences in baseline ARU in the aspirin groups or in PRU in the dual anti-platelet groups. At the PAT there were no statistically significant differences in ARU in subjects on aspirin or PRU in subjects on dual anti-platelet therapy among any of the pelacarsen groups compared to the pooled placebo group (p > 0.05 for all comparisons). Conclusion Pelacarsen does not modify on-treatment platelet reactivity through the thromboxane A 2 or P2Y12 platelet receptor pathways.
--- END ---
